caption: A young woman with long curly red hair, a black wide-brimmed hat, round glasses and a white checkered top stands in the center of a greenhouse. Rows of green tomato plants and pale metal support rails blur behind her. She holds a black tablet in front of her chest, her left hand gripping it from below, her gaze fixed downward on the screen with a faint smile. Throughout the first part of the clip her right index finger hovers near the upper-left edge of the tablet, making small tapping-like adjustments. Her eyes and head shift subtly as she reads, and the framing slowly widens a touch around her. Then that raised right hand lowers and slips out of the bottom of the frame, leaving only the supporting left hand visible. She keeps looking down at the tablet, her expression calm, as the blurred greenery behind her stays unchanged.
